script: Before you accept any new client, check a short list. Have you checked the client's profile and reviews on the platform? Do you have a written brief and a clear price before you start? Has anyone asked you to pay anything to start work? Is the payment method one that you set up yourself? And can you say no without feeling pressure? If you cannot answer yes to the first four, or you feel pressure, say no. If something goes wrong, act quickly. Stop communicating, save screenshots, and report the job or the user to the platform. Tell a trusted friend or family member before you take any other action. And if money was taken from you, contact your bank or payment provider immediately, and follow their steps. Here is a pattern that many new freelancers meet. A new client offers a large job, and asks you to start immediately. They send a payment, but the amount is higher than agreed, and they ask you to send back the difference. This is a common trick.
